flows.title: Add a scene to a video
steps: Open the video and select Add scene in the canvas toolbar.
Choose a blank scene, or pick a Template option.
The new scene appears in the scene list directly after the scene you were on.
A scene holds an avatar, text, images and video clips together, the way a slide does in a presentation.

flows.title: Reuse a scene in another video
steps: Open the video that has the scene you want to reuse.

In the scene menu, right-click the scene and select Copy, or press Command + C on a Mac or Ctrl + C on Windows. Selecting a scene and pressing Command or Ctrl + A takes all of them, and Shift picks several.
Open the video you want it in, right-click in the scene bar and select Paste, or press Command + V or Ctrl + V.
The pasted scene brings its visual and audio elements, animations and full script with it.
When the two videos' scenes run to different lengths, animation timing may not line up: drag the animations along the Timeline, holding Shift to snap them to words in the script.

flows.title: Turn PowerPoint slides into a video
steps: Click the Import PowerPoint option on the home screen.
Upload or drag and drop your PowerPoint file.
Select the toggle options you want for the project.
Click Import. Text, shapes, images, videos and tables arrive editable, and speaker notes become the script — where a slide has none, Synthesia writes a script from what is on the slide.
Fonts are detected automatically; for any that are missing, choose a replacement or upload the original files to keep the design.
